First set of GST changes from the 57th GST Council applies from 1 November 2026
items.summary: The Government has notified the first set of changes recommended by the 57th GST Council meeting of 8 October 2026, covering areas such as refunds, return filing and input tax credit.

items.title: CBIC Circulars 257 to 264 of 2026-GST implement 57th GST Council decisions
items.summary: Eight circulars dated 26 October 2026 cover registration, notices, adjudication and first appeals, pre-deposit, Input Service Distributors, banks and NBFCs under section 17(4), demo vehicles, export proceeds and rule 96(10).

items.title: Circular 258/04/2026-GST: specific evidence needed before invoking fraud provisions
items.summary: Sections 74(1) and 74A(5)(ii) of the CGST Act cannot be invoked merely for non-payment of GST. Officers need specific evidence of fraud, wilful misstatement or suppression with intent to evade tax, and multi-year notices are to be split by year.

items.title: Circular 257/03/2026-GST: guidelines on documents for GST registration
items.summary: Sets out the documents applicants need for registration, including a co-working space declared as the principal place of business, and discourages unnecessary queries by officers.

items.title: Circular 263/09/2026-GST: zero-rating protected when export proceeds are realised through RBI-permitted methods
items.summary: Eligible exporters keep the zero-rated GST benefit where export proceeds are realised through settlement methods permitted by the RBI.

items.title: General Circular: annual filing deadlines extended without additional fee
items.summary: Annual financial statements (AOC-4 and its variants) for FY 2025-26 can be filed till 31 December 2026, and annual returns (MGT-7 and MGT-7A) till 31 January 2027. The circular does not extend the time for holding AGMs.

items.title: CBDT Notification 136/2026: TDS exemption on New Development Bank INR bond interest
items.summary: Exempts TDS on interest paid by the New Development Bank on its Maharajah INR bonds, for resident and FII holders, from tax year 2026-27.

items.title: Income-tax (Seventh Amendment) Rules, 2026: new Form 173A
items.summary: Form 173A is now needed to claim the exemption on interest and capital gains from government securities under the Income-tax Act, 2025.

items.title: Income-tax (Sixth Amendment) Rules, 2026: Form 161 amended
items.summary: CBDT amended the Income-tax Rules, 2026 and notified the revised Form 161.

items.title: Liquidation Process (Fifth Amendment) Regulations, 2026
items.summary: IBBI notification dated 22 September 2026 amending the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (Liquidation Process) Regulations.

items.title: Income-tax (Fourth Amendment) Rules, 2026: Forms 169 and 171 revised
items.summary: CBDT notification of 17 September 2026 revised Form No. 169 and Form No. 171 under the Income-tax Rules, 2026.

items.title: CCI (Commitment) Amendment Regulations, 2026
items.summary: The window to file commitment applications rises from 45 to 60 days, defective applications can be corrected within 10 working days, and the overall timeline for commitment proceedings goes from 130 to 180 working days. In force from publication.

items.title: Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Amendment Rules, 2026
items.summary: MCA notification dated 12 August 2026 amends the Ind AS rules under the Companies Act, 2013.

items.title: Press Note 3 (2026 Series): FDI carve-out for export-only e-commerce inventory
items.summary: A foreign-funded e-commerce entity may own inventory of India-made goods and sell it abroad. The change takes legal effect only after the foreign exchange rules are amended.

items.title: CBDT FAQs on transition to the Income-tax Act, 2025
items.summary: The FAQs say that notices, assessments, reassessments, penalties and appeals for tax years before 1 April 2026 continue under the Income-tax Act, 1961.

items.title: General Circular 03/2026: CCFS-2026 extended to 31 August 2026
items.summary: The Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026 now runs to 31 August 2026, after MCA21 data centre disruption in June.

items.title: Employees' Pension Scheme, 2026 notified (G.S.R. 527(E))
items.summary: The Labour Ministry notified the Employees' Pension Scheme, 2026 together with the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026. A later corrigendum corrected ten drafting errors in the pension scheme.

items.title: General Circular 02/2026: DPT-3 deadline extended to 31 July 2026
items.summary: The DPT-3 (return of deposits) filing for FY 2025-26 can be made till 31 July 2026 without additional fees.

items.title: Notification 21/2026-Customs (T): duty exemption for tariff item 26020010
items.summary: Amends Notification 62/2022-Customs to exempt goods under this tariff item from basic customs duty.

items.title: G.S.R. 432(E): minimum capital for Registered Valuers Organisations
items.summary: Amends the valuer rules to require paid-up share capital of at least ₹25 lakh, with transition time for existing organisations until 31 March 2028.

items.title: G.S.R. 415(E): Companies (Corporate Social Responsibility Policy) Amendment Rules, 2026
items.summary: Amends the Companies (Corporate Social Responsibility Policy) Rules, 2014. The amendment came into force on 29 May 2026.

items.title: S.O. 2625(E): key provisions of the IBC Amendment Act, 2026 in force from 26 May 2026
items.summary: Brings into force several provisions of the Act, including the creditor-initiated insolvency resolution process (Chapter IV-A) and amendments on liquidation.

items.title: Circular on appearance through video conferencing or physical mode
items.summary: Supreme Court circular dated 18 May 2026 on how counsel may appear in hearings.

items.title: Central Rules notified under all four Labour Codes, with Model Standing Orders, 2026
items.summary: Rules under the Wages, Industrial Relations, Social Security and Occupational Safety Codes apply to establishments where the Central Government is the appropriate government. State rules apply to the rest.

items.title: Notification 01/2026-Central Tax (Rate): beverage rates aligned
items.summary: Updates the list of goods with specific GST rates to match the Finance Act 2026.

items.title: Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Amendment Rules, 2026: DIR-3 KYC fees
items.summary: Timely DIR-3 KYC filing stays free. Delayed filing for DIN reactivation attracts a fee of ₹5,000, and a modification filing costs ₹500.

items.title: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (Amendment) Act, 2026 receives assent
items.summary: Act No. 6 of 2026 changes admission and timelines in the corporate insolvency process, liquidation, creditor-initiated resolution and key definitions. Provisions apply from dates the Government notifies.

items.title: CBDT revised guidelines on Document Identification Numbers (DIN)
items.summary: The new circular replaces the 2019 circular. Every notice, order, summons or other communication from an income-tax authority must carry a computer-generated DIN, in line with new section 292BA.

items.title: Notification 22/2026: Income-tax Rules, 2026 notified
items.summary: The new rules under the Income-tax Act, 2025 replace the 1962 Rules and apply from 1 April 2026.

items.title: Circular F.No. 3/Judl./2026: procedure for letters seeking adjournment
items.summary: Fresh directions on circulating adjournment letters, superseding the circulars of 29 November and 2 December 2025.

items.title: Press Note 3 (2020) amended for investors from land-border countries
items.summary: Investors from countries sharing a land border with India may hold up to 10% non-controlling stakes under the automatic route.

items.title: 60-day deadline for select FDI proposals from land-border countries
items.summary: Proposals in sectors such as batteries, rare earths and electronics are to be processed within 60 days under revised Press Note 3 norms.

items.title: Companies (Accounting Standards) Amendment Rules, 2026
items.summary: Amends Accounting Standard 22 for the OECD Pillar Two global minimum tax, adding a deferred tax exception and new disclosure requirements.

items.title: General Circular 01/2026: Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme, 2026
items.summary: A one-time scheme for companies to clear pending annual filings, with reduced additional fees, or to apply for dormant status or strike-off.

items.title: 100% FDI allowed in insurance companies under the automatic route
items.summary: DPIIT amended the Consolidated FDI Policy to permit 100% foreign investment in insurance companies without prior approval.

items.title: Guidelines for Designation of Senior Advocates by the Supreme Court of India, 2026
items.summary: The Supreme Court published fresh guidelines on designating Senior Advocates and followed them with notices on the designation process.

items.title: G.S.R. 108(E): revised startup recognition framework with a Deep Tech category
items.summary: Replaces the 2019 notification. The turnover limit for startups rises to ₹200 crore, and Deep Tech startups get a 20-year recognition period and a higher limit of ₹300 crore.
